docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Over two hundred fables, with their morals.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

The fables attributed to Aesop (about 600 BC), in the English version of V. S. Vernon Jones (1867–1940), 1912, with illustrations by Arthur Rackham (1867–1939). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
